study_info.title: Effect of vitamin D on all-cause mortality in heart failure (EVITA): a 3-year randomized clinical trial with 4000 IU vitamin D daily
study_info.authors: Armin Zittermann, Jana B. Ernst, Sylvana Prokop, Uwe Fuchs, Jens Dreier, Joachim Kuhn, Cornelius Knabbe, Ingvild Birschmann, Uwe Schulz, Heiner K. Berthold, Stefan Pilz, Ioanna Gouni-Berthold, Jan F. Gummert, Marcus Dittrich, Jochen Borgermann
study_info.study_design: Investigator-initiated, single-center, prospective, randomized, placebo-controlled clinical trial. Randomization was computer based in blocks of six and stratified by sex.
study_info.inclusion_criteria: Patients with heart failure who attended the HF unit, aged 18–79 years, classified as New York Heart Association functional class II or higher, either in a long-term program for heart transplantation or already listed as 'elective' for heart transplantation.
study_info.exclusion_criteria: ‘High urgent’ listing for heart transplantation, hypercalcaemia (plasma calcium >2.75mmol/L), supplemental vitamin D intake >800 IU/d, and baseline 25-hydroxyvitamin D levels ≥75nmol/L.
study_info.study_setting: Clinic for Thoracic and Cardiovascular Surgery of the Heart and Diabetes Center North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
study_info.source_of_recruitment: Patients with HF who attended the HF unit of our clinic
study_info.dropout_reasons: Patients were excluded from further study participation in case of hypercalcaemia (reference range of our laboratory: 2.1–2.75mmol/L) or of 25OHD levels >374nmol/L.

minimal_units.intervention_details: 4000 IU vitamin D3 daily, administered as eight drops of an oily vitamin D preparation (Vigantol oil, Merck, Darmstadt, Germany) during a meal, for 3 years.

outcomes.comparison_targets: Vitamin D group vs Placebo group

minimal_units.control_details: Matching placebo, administered as eight drops of a vitamin D–free oil (Migliol oil; Merck) daily during a meal, for 3 years.

outcomes.comparison_targets: vitamin D group vs placebo group

meta_analysis_parameters.outcome_domain: major adverse cardiovascular events；myocardial infarction；stroke or cerebrovascular events；cardiovascular disease mortality；all-cause mortality
